_comment: The Rust half is deny.toml's [licenses].allow list, copied verbatim, and about.toml's accepted list.
The npm half adds OFL-1.1 (the two self-hosted fonts) and BlueOak-1.0.0 (lru-cache/minimatch v11),
both approved by Luke on 2026-11-05 in issue #167. Build-time-only CC-BY-4.0 and LGPL-3.0-or-later
are not accepted: the packages carrying them (caniuse-lite, sharp/libvips) never reach the static export.
